items.why: Chip selloff continues. Barron's tied this week's slide to CoreWeave bond yields topping 15%, reviving fears the AI buildout is over levered. Nvidia's new RTX Spark PC chip added competitive pressure in premarket.
Sliding after a Guggenheim analyst raised Meta's 2027 capex estimate to $225 billion, per Barron's, well above company guidance. Traders also de risking ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct 21.
Nasdaq futures lower as the chip rout weighs on tech. CoreWeave's bond selloff keeps AI spending doubts alive, and investors keep rotating from growth toward value.
Drifting with the tech complex despite JPMorgan raising its target to $425 on Google Cloud and TPU strength. Barron's says Alphabet's Oct 28 earnings could make or break the AI bull run.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down ~1% while Dow futures climb; AI capex fears are driving the split.
summary: Tech leads the tape lower Friday morning as the AI trade keeps wobbling. Chipmakers and megacap AI names are slipping on worries about debt funded AI spending, while Dow futures edge up on rotation into value.
